resources.string: Shows Scan, Tick, Clear and Book buttons over any app, all working through accessibility (no screenshots). Scan lists everything the app reports on the screen - every element, its text, state and actions, the pop-ups, checkboxes, calendar and dropdown. Tick ticks every checkbox and clears the pop-ups; Clear clears the pop-ups up now; Book picks the option, the date in the calendar, the checkbox, the radio button and Continue.
